title: Binding of gp37 LTF Needle Trimers to E. coli
author: Mohammad Z. Islam
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.77xhrpn
materials: Denature the protein by boiling for 7 min.

After blocking with casein blocking buffer (Sigma Aldrich, St. Louis, MO) buffer or 5% skim milk in PBS containing 0.05% Tween 20 (PBS-T), incubate the membrane with monoclonal anti-histag antibodies (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA) at 37ºC for 2 hr to detect the bound his-tagged gp37 protein.
After washing four times with PBS-T, add horseradish peroxidase (HRP)-conjugated rabbit anti-mouse IgG (Invitrogen, Camarillo, CA), and incubate for 1 hour at 37ºC.
Expose the membrane to an X-ray film or image with Chemidoc (Bio-Rad laboratories).

steps.title: Harvest and centrifuge E. coli cells
steps.instruction: Take freshly grown 10^8 E. coli cells and centrifuge at 2,300 g for 3 min at 4 °C in a low‑bind Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Resuspend cells and add gp37 trimers
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS, pH 7.4) and add purified his‑tagged gp37 LTF needle trimers at approximately 3 × 10^5 molecules per cell, bringing the total reaction volume to 150 µL.

steps.title: Incubate binding reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 2 h.

steps.title: Pellet and wash cells
steps.instruction: Sediment the cells by centrifugation and wash the pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 2,300 g for 3 min at 4 °C.
Wash the pellet twice with 1 mL PBS.

steps.title: Prepare samples with SDS buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet and add SDS sample buffer.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 10 µL PBS.
Add 10 µL of 2X SDS sample buffer.

steps.title: Transfer proteins to PVDF membrane
steps.instruction: Perform Western blotting by transferring the proteins from the gel onto a polyvinylidene difluoride (PVDF) membrane.

steps.title: Wash membrane and add ECL reagent
steps.instruction: Detect bound proteins on the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Wash the membrane four times with PBS‑T.
Add the ECL reagent (Pierce Biotechnology, Rockford, IL).

steps.title: Set up negative control reactions
steps.instruction: In each experiment include two controls: (i) omit gp37 trimers, and (ii) omit E. coli cells.
